title: Kohler refuses to name his sources

tellings.quote: The information it was told to me as a story. However, the names where I got it from was entrusted to me as a confidency

plain: George Kohler, who in 1950 spoke on KMYR, a radio station in Denver, Colorado, about a story of crashed alien bodies, is heard refusing to name where he got it. He says the information was told to him as a story, but the names of his sources were given to him in confidence. If true, it would mean people in the know passed him the account privately and wanted to stay hidden.
